pantalla.etiqueta: Who says it all costs more?

titulo: Everything costs more? GTA 6 at $80 costs less than the last one.
descripcion:
Worth it? Is it worth the price? Here is the math.

Grand Theft Auto VI launches Nov 19, 2026 at $79.99; the Ultimate Edition is $99.99 (Take-Two Interactive, the game's publisher, press release of Jun 24, 2026). Grand Theft Auto V launched at $59.99 in 2013 (TechTimes, a tech news site, Nov 9, 2026). Moved to today's dollars with the US Bureau of Labor Statistics consumer price index (234.149 in Sept 2013, 337.511 in Oct 2026), $59.99 is about $86 (59.99 x 337.511 / 234.149 = 86.47). The standard game is about $6 below that; the Ultimate Edition is about $14 above it. The arithmetic is ours. The voice is synthetic.

Sources:
https://www.take2games.com/ir/news/rockstar-games-announces-pre-orders-grand-theft-auto-vi
https://api.bls.gov/publicAPI/v1/timeseries/data/CUUR0000SA0
https://www.techtimes.com/articles/330294/20261109/gta-vi-pre-orders-surpass-750-million-take-two-reports-q2-earnings-monday.htm
comentario_fijado: The math: $59.99 in Sept 2013 x 337.511 / 234.149 (US consumer price index) = about $86 today. GTA VI is $79.99, the Ultimate Edition $99.99.
